images.finding: Panel crop at desktop: heading, retained-only scope, parent label/select and Refresh action are readable. Disabled parent pagination fits. No preparation action or attempt/capture selector is exposed without a parent.

Full-page desktop capture: the new import card is distinct from historical source capture and fits the page. The complete empty migration screen contains no captured/imported customer rows. Full-page framing includes fixed navigation at the current scroll position.

Panel crop at 390px viewport: heading and scope wrap, Refresh and disabled pagination remain fully visible. The native select shortens its placeholder within its fixed width; the complete field label remains visible. No clipped or unreachable action was observed.

Full-page narrow capture: migration cards stack vertically and the new import card remains within the page width. Its detailed controls were inspected in the separate native-width panel crop. This long full-page image was display-resized; it is not a claim to inspect every existing card control at native scale.

viewport_qualification: Desktop 1360x950 and mobile390x844. Panel screenshots are crops, and full-page screenshots extend beyond the viewport. Browser metrics report no document horizontal overflow and all new panel buttons in viewport horizontal bounds with height40px.
limitations: Empty shared-development release only. No eligible People import exists, so this smoke does not exercise populated preparation/confirmation, import execution, or Person timeline/detail; those are separate implementation walkthrough evidence.
